title: Ordering Lunch for Different Needs
instructions: 这是为A1学习者设计的原创听力练习，主题是“为不同需求点简单餐食”。请先听对话（或阅读文本），然后完成8道题。题目均为英文，解释为中文。注意：对话中有自然纠正和干扰信息，答案需根据原文直接判断。本材料为模拟教学材料，不是官方雅思考试。
transcript: Mia: Hi, I'm Mia. I want lunch for my family. Tom: Hello. What do you need? Mia: My son likes noodles, but he cannot eat eggs. Tom: OK. Noodles, no eggs. And your daughter? Mia: She likes rice. She can eat eggs. Tom: Rice with eggs. Does she like vegetables? Mia: No, she doesn't. Tom: And you? Mia: I like soup. I can eat chicken. Tom: Chicken soup. Does your husband like soup? Mia: No, he doesn't. He likes bread and cheese. Tom: Bread and cheese. One more thing: does he eat fish? Mia: Yes, he does. But he cannot eat nuts. Tom: OK. No nuts. Your lunch is ready soon.

grammar.title: 第三人称单数；do/does问答；like；can/cannot；and/but
grammar.explanation: 在英语中，当主语是第三人称单数（he, she, it）时，动词一般现在时需要加-s或-es。例如：like变成likes，eat变成eats。否定句用doesn't + 动词原形。疑问句用Does + 主语 + 动词原形？回答用Yes, he/she does. 或 No, he/she doesn't. can表示能力，后接动词原形；cannot表示不能。and连接并列，but表示转折。
grammar.example: My son likes noodles, but he cannot eat eggs.

can是情态动词，后接动词原形，没有人称变化。
